results.title: The Archivist
results.overview: David "Doc" Rowe has spent decades documenting Britain's vibrant folk traditions. Now, with time running short, he faces a race to preserve his legacy.

results.original_title: Paul Heaton: Live at Bramall Lane
results.overview: Paul Heaton returns to Sheffield for a landmark homecoming performance at Bramall Lane, delivering a career-spanning set packed with legendary hits and fan favourites.

results.title: Our Walls
results.overview: An animated documentary that, through an intimate conversation between a daughter and a mother, searches for understaning and explores family bonds. The film reveals the inner conflict between freedom and sacrifice. Gradually, walls that connect and confine us across generations emerge, shaping who we are to ourselves and to one another.

results.title: Wing Commander II
results.overview: This is loosely based or inspired by the wing commander game series and the wing commander movie from Chris Roberts. During the continuing of the Kilrathi war, the TCS Tiger Claw get destroyed by cloaking freighters, while Blair is accused and investigated for treason the story follows another pilot Michel Casey Callsign Iceman who has been ordered to be a combat pilot at TCS Concordia where he his wing-man Mariko Tanaka Callsign Spirit. They fall in love with each other but unfortunately they are under attack by unknown vessels with cloaking devices. After the attack they get separated, Iceman wake up in an unknown planet where he get help from a former Kilrathi fighter pilot Hobbes.

results.title: Antonio's Road
results.overview: It's 1929. Antonio immigrates from Italy to become a success as an artist in America. Mary leaves Ireland to make a better life for her child. Their paths cross again and again as their dreams are crushed. It will take the next generation to make it in America.

results.title: Caio

results.overview: A thirty-something slacker goes on a quest with his introvert teenage nephew to find a Bullet Man action figure.

results.title: Двойник
results.overview: The 1980s, New Year's Eve. In a quiet Soviet town, a local police officer finds himself at the center of unsettling and inexplicable events. As he investigates, he is drawn ever deeper into a world where the line between reality and delusion blurs.

results.title: Florescence
results.overview: A young married couple retreat to an English country house in an attempt to salvage Lucy's worsening mental health. John's strict instructions and their self-imposed isolation pushes their relationship to breaking point and Lucy begins to experience strange phenomena in the house.

results.title: Krantijyoti Vidyalay Marathi Madhyam
results.overview: Students and teachers from a Marathi school come together to save their school from demolition, as an international school is set to be built in its place. Personal challenges merge with institutional struggles as they seek preservation of Marathi-medium schools and their local culture, while also acknowledging the need for change.

results.title: Nonna Lucia
results.overview: By looking at all the objects left behind by my grandmother after her death, we reflect on the meaning of these objects and the stories they tell.

results.title: Piyak Oskân
results.overview: Piyak Oskân, meaning "family" in Michif, tells the story of Rose, a Métis woman who grows up and falls in love in her Road Allowance community. However, the Saskatchewan government imposes strict conditions on her family, drastically changing their lives.
